offerings.name: Google Search API (SERP API)
offerings.pricing: Top-up model, no monthly subscriptions. Starter $50 (50k credits, $1.00/1k); Standard $375 (500k credits, $0.75/1k); Scale $1250 (2.5M credits, $0.50/1k); Ultimate $3750 (12.5M credits, $0.30/1k). Excluding sales tax/VAT/GST.
offerings.price_basis: Starter 档 $50 充值包，$1.00/1k credits（1 credit/查询）
offerings.free_quota: Get 2,500 free queries / No credit card required
offerings.note: 1-2秒返回真实时结果（不缓存）；支持 Search/Images/News/Maps/Places/Videos/Shopping/Scholar/Patents/Autocomplete；可自定义国家与语言；QPS 50（Starter）至 300（Ultimate）；credits 6 个月有效，超过 20% 用量不可退款。
